mapper.select: SELECT member_id AS memberId, login_id AS loginId, password_hash AS passwordHash, name, email, birth_date AS birthDate, phone, zip_code AS zipCode, address, status, role, grade_id AS gradeId, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt, last_login_at AS lastLoginAt, oauth_provider AS oauthProvider, oauth_id AS oauthId from member where login_id = #{value}

SELECT member_id AS memberId, login_id AS loginId, password_hash AS passwordHash, name, email, birth_date AS birthDate, phone, zip_code AS zipCode, address, status, role, grade_id AS gradeId, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt, last_login_at AS lastLoginAt, oauth_provider AS oauthProvider, oauth_id AS oauthId from member where oauth_id = #{oauthId} AND oauth_provider = #{oauthProvider}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO member ( login_id, password_hash, name, email, birth_date, phone, zip_code, address, status, role, grade_id, oauth_provider, oauth_id, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{loginId}, #{passwordHash}, #{name}, #{email}, #{birthDate}, #{phone}, #{zipCode}, #{address}, #{status}, #{role}, #{gradeId}, #{oauthProvider}, #{oauthId}, NOW(), NOW() )
mapper.select:
SELECT m.member_id AS memberId, m.login_id AS loginId, m.name, m.email, m.phone, m.status, m.role, m.grade_id AS gradeId, m.created_at AS createdAt FROM member m WHERE 1=1
AND m.status = #{status}
AND ( m.login_id LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR m.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR m.phone LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') )
ORDER BY m.created_at DESC

SELECT m.member_id as memberId, m.login_id as loginId, m.name, m.email, m.birth_date as birthDate, m.phone, m.zip_code as zipCode, m.address, m.status, m.role, m.created_at as createdAt, m.updated_at as updatedAt, m.last_login_at as lastLoginAt, m.oauth_provider as oauthProvider, m.oauth_id as oauthId, g.grade_id as gradeId, g.grade_name AS gradeName FROM member m LEFT JOIN grade g ON m.grade_id = g.grade_id WHERE m.member_id = #{value}
SELECT member_id as memberId, CONCAT(LEFT(login_id, 3), '*******') as loginId, name, status FROM member where member_id = #{memberId} and status = 'normal'

SELECT member_id AS memberId, login_id AS loginId, password_hash AS passwordHash, name, email, birth_date AS birthDate, phone, zip_code AS zipCode, address, status, role, grade_id AS gradeId, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt, last_login_at AS lastLoginAt, oauth_provider AS oauthProvider, oauth_id AS oauthId FROM member WHERE member_id = #{value}
mapper.update: UPDATE member SET email = #{email}, birth_date = #{birthDate}, phone = #{phone}, zip_code = #{zipCode}, address = #{address}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE member_id = #{memberId}
UPDATE member SET password_hash = #{passwordHash}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE member_id = #{memberId}
